section.title: org.osgi.service.onem2m.dto
section.para: Service Layer Data Transfer Objects for oneM2M Specification Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

listitem.para: Constants - This class defines constants for resource types.
GenericDTO - GenericDTO expresses miscellaneous data structures of oneM2M.
IPEDiscoveryRequestDTO - IPEDiscoveryRequestDTO is an element of NotificationEventDTO
ReleaseVersion - enum expresses oneM2M specification version.

section.title: public class AttributeDTO extends DTO
section.para: This class is typically used in FilterCriteriaDTO for expressing matching condition.

section.title: public String name
section.para: name of the child resource pointed to by the URI

section.title: public String specializationID
section.para: resource type specialization of the child resource pointed to by the URI in case type represents a flexContainer. This is an optional field.

section.title: public Integer type
section.para: resourceType of the child resource pointed to by the URI

section.title: public final class Constants
section.para: This class defines constants for resource types.

section.title: public class DasInfoDTO extends DTO
section.para: DTO expresses DasInfo. DAS is short for Dynamic Authorization Server.

formalpara.title: See Also
formalpara.para: oneM2M TS-0004 6.3.5.45, oneM2M XSD dynAuthTokenReqInfo and dasInfo

section.title: public GenericDTO dasRequest
section.para: Information to send to the Dynamic Authorization Server

section.title: public String securedDasRequest
section.para: Secured Information to send to the Dynamic Authorization Server. JWS or JWE is assigned to this field.

section.title: public class FilterCriteriaDTO extends DTO
section.para: DTO expresses FilterCriteria. This data structure is used for searching resources.

section.title: public class GenericDTO extends DTO
section.para: GenericDTO expresses miscellaneous data structures of oneM2M.

section.title: public Map<String, Object> element
section.para: Substructure of DTO. Type of the value part should be one of types allowed as OSGi DTO.

section.title: public class IPEDiscoveryRequestDTO extends DTO
section.para: IPEDiscoveryRequestDTO is an element of NotificationEventDTO

section.title: public Boolean subscriptionDeletion
section.para: Flag showing subscription deletion This field is optional.

section.title: public Boolean verificationRequest
section.para: Flag showing verification request. This field is optional.

section.title: public class NotificationEventDTO
section.para: This data structure is held in NotificationDTO.

section.title: public class PrimitiveContentDTO extends DTO
section.para: This Data structure is used as union. Only one field MUST have a value, the others MUST be null.

formalpara.title: See Also
formalpara.para: oneM2M TS-0004 6.3.5.5, oneM2M TS-0004 7.2.1, oneM2M XSD primitiveContent

section.title: enum ReleaseVersion
section.para: This information is introduced after Release 2.0 and oneM2M uses only R2A, R3_0 (as 2a and 3).

section.title: public List<String> authorizationSignatures
section.para: In oneM2M this parameter is expressed in m2m:signatureList.

section.title: public Boolean deliveryAggregation
section.para: This parameter is related to CMDH(Communication Management and Delivery Handling) policy.

section.title: public DesiredIdentifierResultType desiredIdentifierResultType
section.para: This parameter specifies identifier type in response, such as structured or unstructured. This parameter used to be Discovery Result Type in previous oneM2M release.

section.title: public Integer eventCategory
section.para: allowed values are 2(Immediate), 3(BestEffort), 4(Latest), and 100-999 as user defined range.

formalpara.title: See Also
formalpara.para: oneM2M TS-0004 6.3.3, oneM2M XSD eventCat, oneM2M XSD stdEventCats

section.title: public String from
section.para: Originator of the request is stored.

section.title: public String groupRequestIdentifier
section.para: Group Request Identifier TODO: search doc.

section.title: public List<String> localTokenIDs
section.para: In oneM2M this parameter is expressed as list of xs:NCName.

section.title: public String requestExpirationTimestamp
section.para: * This parameter is related to CMDH(Communication Management and Delivery Handling) policy.

section.title: public String resultExpirationTimestamp
section.para: This parameter is related to CMDH(Communication Management and Delivery Handling) policy.

section.title: public String resultPersistence
section.para: This parameter is related to CMDH(Communication Management and Delivery Handling) policy.

section.title: public List<String> tokenIDs
section.para: In oneM2M this parameter is expressed as list of m2m:tokenID.

section.title: public String vendorInformation
section.para: Used for vendor specific information. No procedure is defined for the parameter.

section.title: public class ResourceDTO extends DTO
section.para: Universal attributes are expressed in field of the class. Common attributes and other attributes are stored in attribute field.

section.title: public Map<String, Object> attribute
section.para: Non Universal Attribute. Value Part must be the types that are allowed for OSGi DTO. In case of value part can be expressed DTO in this package, the DTO must be used. In case of value part have sub-elements, GenericDTO must be used.

section.title: public String parentID
section.para: Parent ID Resource ID of parent resource.

section.title: public Integer eventCategory
section.para: allowed values are 2(Immediate), 3(BestEffort), 4(Latest), and 100-999 as user defined range.

formalpara.title: See Also
formalpara.para: oneM2M TS-0004 6.3.3, oneM2M XSD eventCat, oneM2M XSD stdEventCats

section.title: public String vendorInformation
section.para: Used for vendor specific information. No procedure is defined for the parameter.

section.title: public class SecurityInfoDTO extends DTO
section.para: This class is used as union. SecurityInfoType field indicates which type of content is stored.
